title: Quaint Smoky Greek Shrimp Gyro
description: A smoky and cozy Greek dish featuring shrimp, sriracha, and lardons, served in a gyro format and perfect for a pescatarian meal, presented in a bento box for a unique twist.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium high heat.
In a bowl, whisk together sriracha, olive oil, and a pinch of salt.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the sriracha mixture.
Grill the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the gyro by spreading a layer of feta cheese on the pita, then adding a few shrimp, some tomato, and some red onion.
Drizzle the rendered lardons over the top of the gyro.
Serve the gyro in a bento box with a side of tomato and red onion.
Garnish with a sprinkle of feta cheese and a few slices of lardons.
